stops_done.name: stops_done
stops_done.value: ("stops"."outcome" is null and "stops"."done_at" is null) or ("stops"."outcome" is not null and "stops"."done_at" is not null and "stops"."arrived_at" is not null)

issues_decided.name: issues_decided
issues_decided.value:
("issues"."status" = 'open' and "issues"."decision" is null and "issues"."decided_by" is null and "issues"."decided_at" is null)
    or ("issues"."status" = 'decided' and "issues"."decision" is not null and "issues"."decided_by" is not null and "issues"."decided_at" is not null)
